integrity: The harvested Hutchinson–Wright equation was checked against a complete same-model 2014 treatment containing the positive equilibrium, delay-dependent stability changes, Hopf behavior, and numerical averages. That article was inspected at the model, harvesting, bifurcation, and average-population sections, and targeted full-document searches covered conditional expectation, covariance, moment, autocorrelation, and mean formulations. A modern complete open treatment of the unharvested Hutchinson equation was compared for Wright-equation equivalence, periodic-orbit, and global-dynamics coverage. The original 1948 source was used only for model provenance and its verified day-resolved publication date because complete text was unavailable through the bounded checked routes. The conditional regression, covariance law, activity identity, equality class, and crossing consequence were reconstructed independently and replayed with the packaged exact checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures on strictly positive histories.
It constrains stationary states that exist; it does not assert existence for every parameter set below the harvesting threshold.
The original 1948 article was used for provenance and date because a complete machine-readable copy was unavailable through the bounded checked access routes.
The exact mean law sharpens a numerical same-model observation; the strongest originality claim is the conditional regression, lag decorrelation, and activity identity.
An equivalent short logarithmic-generator formulation could remain in older unindexed delay-equation literature.
title: Exact lag-\(\tau\) decorrelation and mean locking in the harvested Hutchinson–Wright equation
